item.title: Kuwai na Shock!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Megami
  • 発売日: 2003-12-05
  • スコア: 6.1899999999999995/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: くわいなしょっく！
  • 英語名: Kuwai na Shock!

别名

  • Kwai na Shock

あらすじ

Sakaki Arima is a private detective. He only works on cases related to youkai. He has ability to strengthen himself by having sex with female youkai, but he need to do it regularly. One day, he received a strange letter with only one sentence: “I want to see the sun”. At the same time youkai catgirl came to his office and forced him to take this task…

item.title: Kingin☆Heart☆Succubus!
item.description:

  • 発売日: 2003-03-28
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: きんぎん☆はぁと☆さっきゅばす！
  • 英語名: Kingin☆Heart☆Succubus!

别名

  • Kin-Gin

あらすじ

Partly against his own will, Ataru has been specially chosen for an unimaginably important task: aiding three promising succubus achieve demonic transcendence. To do this he must rigorously assess the sexual performance of his charges, and in the process temper their strengths while correcting weaknesses. The reward for success is beyond anything his mortal mind could ever comprehend, yet the the punishment for failure is equally as incomprehensible.

  • 英語名: Bakuetsu! Chimou Yuugi “Kakutou Shimai Monmon Hen”

あらすじ

Main character’s plans to live by holding a dojo fail. He goes to his sister’s dojo to challenge her and collapses there. After being fed, he challenges sister, and with some side support the fight ends in a draw. Then the sides to settle the dispute by running dojo again. And to reduce protagonist’s chances of winning girls prepare special training sessions for him each day.

  • 日本語名: 夢現 Ｄｒｅａｍｙ －ゆめうつつ－
  • 英語名: Yume Utsutsu

别名

  • Dreamy

あらすじ

One day Naoki picks up a mysterious pendant hanging on a telephone pole on the way back from school. On that night two fairies came to his dream saying that an angel could return to the original world if Naoki could make some girls happy during the next ten days. He decides to sleep as much as possible during next ten days and girls start to come to his dreams…
